1.name: Process Technology

1.notes: Focuses on process design criteria, flowsheet and P&ID development, hazard and operability studies (HAZOP), and process calculations. Track B includes key lists such as battery limits conditions and fluid codes, which are essential structured data for process design.

4.name: Equipment
track_a_files: 4-DST-XXXX-R0 [Template S & T Heat Exchanger - Vdr Package].xls
4.notes: Covers equipment design criteria, specifications, and various calculations (CAL, SCR). Includes numerous process data sheets (PDS, DST) and fixed equipment inspection checklists (FIC) which are structured forms for equipment parameters. Track B contains equipment lists and numbering standards, providing structured data for equipment management.

5.name: Piping & Layout
track_b_files: 5-SPC-TC3-R0 PTFE Lined Carbon Steel Pipe - Field.xls
5-SPC-TC4-R1 PTFE Lined Carbon Steel Pipe - Spooled.xls
5.notes: Covers piping design criteria, numbering, layout review, and detailed specifications for various piping materials and components. Track B is extensive, containing numerous piping service lists, line lists, and detailed piping specifications in Excel format, which are ideal for structured data management and querying.

6.name: Insulation
6.notes: Contains procedures for insulation design and specification. This discipline is primarily narrative-based.

7.name: Coatings
7.notes: Includes procedures and specifications for protective coatings, including those for underground piping. This discipline is primarily narrative-based.

8.name: Instrumentation & Control
8.notes: Focuses on instrumentation and control system design criteria, numbering, and checkout procedures. Track B contains various instrument process data lists and checkout lists, which are structured data essential for instrument management and commissioning.

9.name: Electrical
9.notes: Covers electrical equipment identification, numbering, design, specifications, and system checkout procedures. Track B includes an electrical document numbering standard and numerous contractor and specialist field checklists, providing structured data for electrical system management and quality control.

notes: The corpus is well-organized by discipline, with a clear distinction between narrative/procedural documents (Track A) and structured data/lists (Track B). There is a strong emphasis on standardization, with many templates and procedures for document control, project management, and technical design. Cross-referencing is common, indicating an interconnected knowledge base. Excel files are frequently used for both data storage and structured forms/calculations, requiring careful distinction for processing. The 'Unknown' discipline (-1) contains miscellaneous files, often appendices or generic templates, that support the main disciplines.
